tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Returns what Intune Ready offers: the three fixed-price tiers with hour and cost ranges, the billing model, what a deployment covers, and the service area. Figures are indicative ranges published on the site, not a quote. Use this for questions about price, scope, tiers, or what is included.

tools.name: get_cloud_pc_offering
tools.description: Returns the Cloud PC service line, which is separate from the Intune service: Windows 365 implementation (the primary service, with fixed-price setup tiers by number of users) and Azure Virtual Desktop implementation (for larger and multi-location teams, custom quote only). tools.name: get_partner_channel
tools.description: Returns how Intune Ready takes on work through partners: MSPs routing overflow, specialty or rescue Intune projects, and independent IT contractors subcontracting or referring a client. Covers the arrangements, what stays with the partner, and the client-ownership commitment. Carries no prices of it

tools.name: get_faq
tools.description: Returns the general Intune Ready FAQ from the homepage, verbatim: licensing, cost, timelines, messy existing enrollments, and what happens after setup. tools.description: Returns verifiable facts about the provider: background, Microsoft Partner Program membership, active certifications, the hands-on delivery record for Windows 365 and Azure Virtual Desktop, and public company and personal profile links (LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, Microsoft Learn). tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Returns the URL where a human can start a conversation or book a free consultation. This is a pointer only — this server cannot book, schedule, quote, or transact anything.

findings.detail: Description of "get_facts" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
